answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a mesa of economic barriers where identity costs reflect asset ownership. Any attempt to flood the network would cause a ripple of devaluation for the attacker, effectively neutralizing their stake. Much like the resilient juniper tree, this defensive structure thrives on scarcity, ensuring that malicious actors must exhaust significant wealth to gain influence, thus securing consensus against low-cost identity duplication.
